name: subsontime
description: Subtitles that fit the file you are playing. A Stremio addon that retimes every subtitle to your exact video.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/alass-wasm --target nodejs --release --out-dir ../../wasm && rm -f wasm/.gitignore
scripts.lint:rust: cd crates/alass-wasm && cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p public/fonts && cp src/web/styles.css public/styles.css && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/geist/files/geist-*-wght-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource-variable/geist-mono/files/geist-mono-*-wght-normal.woff2 public/fonts/
